## Description

Worker drafts the note per the encounter template using Azure OpenAI with a JSON schema: each field has text, evidence links (transcript segment ids or verified chart refs), speaker, flags (warn: e.g. stated by companion / dose stated once; conflict: contradicts chart). Validators reject outputs with unsupported statements, invented negatives, medicines or doses not in evidence. Transcripts treated as untrusted input (instructions inside ignored).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Every drafted statement has ≥ 1 evidence link; statements without evidence are dropped and logged as validator rejections.
- [ ] **AC2.** Medicines and doses in the draft must appear in transcript evidence or the verified chart; otherwise rejected (unit + eval tests).
- [ ] **AC3.** Missing information leaves the field blank with "Not discussed" rather than a guess.
- [ ] **AC4.** Conflicts with verified chart data (e.g. medicine active vs stopped) are flagged as conflict.
- [ ] **AC5.** A prompt-injection phrase inside the transcript does not change behaviour (red-team test).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
